meta.name: alfworld-environment-scanner
meta.description: Performs an initial scan of the ALFWorld environment to identify all visible objects and receptacles. Use when you first enter an environment and need to build a mental map for task planning. Processes raw observation text into a structured list of entities, categorizing them as objects or receptacles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描游戏环境并结构化输出可见实体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在ALFWorld环境中快速获取结构化地图信息。
copy.tagline_en: Scan the ALFWorld environment and output structured entities.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a structured map of visible objects in ALFWorld.

howto.what: 进入 ALFWorld 游戏环境时，自动扫描并列出所有可见的家具（容器）和物品，帮你记住周围有哪些东西可以拿或放。
howto.when: 当模拟器首次给出环境描述（例如“你在一间房间中间”）时自动触发，用于构建初始心理地图。

say.text: 我刚进房间，帮我扫描一下环境。
say.note: Claude 会执行扫描并列出可见物体。

say.text: 告诉我房间里有哪些家具。
say.note: Claude 输出容器和物品列表。

say.text: 开始任务前，先看看周围有什么。
say.note: 触发环境扫描，为后续行动准备。

howto.what_en: When you first enter an ALFWorld environment, this skill automatically scans and lists all visible furniture (receptacles) and objects, helping you remember what is around for task planning.
howto.when_en: Triggered immediately upon receiving the initial environment description from the simulator (e.g., 'You are in the middle of a room...') to build a mental map.

say_en.text: I just entered the room. Scan the environment.
say_en.note: Claude will perform the scan and list visible entities.

say_en.text: Tell me what furniture is in this room.
say_en.note: Claude outputs the list of receptacles and objects.

say_en.text: Before starting the task, look around first.
